Technical Author (multiple roles and seniority levels)

Join to apply for the Technical Author (multiple roles and seniority levels) role at Canonical

Our ambition is to set a standard of excellence in the industry for technical documentation and documentation practice. This is your chance to be a part of that, as a Technical Author at Canonical .
We are building documentation capacity at scale. We have dozens of positions available , for products and teams across the organisation, at all levels from Graduate to Senior Staff.
All applications and candidates are handled through this one entry-point. We'll be able to discuss seniority levels, suitable teams and more later in the process, to help place you in the most suitable role for you.
The role of a Technical Author
A Technical Author leads the documentation efforts of an engineering team, typically focused on a product or family of products. You'll help the team develop documentation that serves the needs of the product's users, embracing the principles of the Diátaxis documentation framework. You will have a broad impact on - and responsibility for - the quality of the user experience with the product, and will contribute towards the long-term success of the project itself.
These are not traditional technical writer roles. As a Technical Author, you will participate in development of product strategy. You will have input into product design and user experience. You will combine technical expertise with leadership in documentation, collaborating with colleagues across the company to establish documentation as a first-class engineering discipline. Even the most junior Technical Authors will have the opportunity to develop and demonstrate technical authority.
As well as your role in an engineering team, you will also be a part of Canonical's documentation practice team, that includes all the company's Technical Authors. Here, you'll be amongst other documentation experts, who collaborate to define documentation excellence and drive the development of documentation practice and theory, across the company and in the open-source software community.
Location: These are fully remote roles, open to candidates across the globe.
The role entails

  • Create, maintain and improve software documentation
  • Work with engineering team members, to help them make effective documentation contributions
  • Influence the development of the product, as an expert user of the product, who has important opinions about its function and design
  • Engage with user communities to ensure that our documentation meets their needs
  • Encourage and support community engagement in and contribution to documentation
  • Help standardise the structure, presentation, style and language of content across products
  • Collaborate with documentation peers to advance the state of the art in documentation at Canonical
  • Challenge and advance documentation understanding and best-practice, as part of a disciplinary team
What we are looking for in you
  • Cares deeply about functional written communication
  • Is a technical writer with a programmer's mindset, or a programmer with a record of producing excellent documentation
  • Has a record of community engagement, in open-source software, documentation, research or other disciplines
  • Is sympathetic to the needs and challenges of open-source software and its communities
  • Demonstrates technical curiosity, and is fascinated by software technology and its challenges
  • Has demonstrable documentation skills, insight and enthusiasm
  • Has experience of software development contexts; is familiar with: Linux, working on the command line, application deployment, system operations, and infrastructure management, Git, documentation markup languages
  • Has excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Holds a BSc/BA degree or equivalent
  • Is able to travel twice a year for up to two weeks for events
Nice-to-have skills
  • Deep technical domain knowledge
  • Open-source community leadership and management
  • User-experience, interaction or visual design
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Fund Accountant, Implementations
description:
The Company You’ll Join

Carta is a platform that helps people manage equity, build businesses, and invest in the companies of tomorrow. Our mission is to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places.

Carta is trusted by more than 40,000 companies and over two million people in nearly 160 countries to manage cap tables, compensation, and valuations. Carta also supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, and represents nearly $130B in assets under administration. Carta's tender offer solutions have returned $14B to shareholders in secondary transactions. Today, Carta’s platform manages nearly three trillion dollars in equity globally.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You’ll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

As an Implementations Accountant, you will focus efforts on supporting new Fund Administration customers in their journey into Carta services. You work within our fast-growing Fund Administration business by coordinating, facilitating and managing onboarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline. You will:

  • Liaise between Sales and Fund Accounting teams as the bridge post-sales for new fund clients
  • Interact with a fund’s back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical accounting data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate financial statements to both the client and internal stakeholders
  • Book and reconcile all accounting books and records from, at times, unstructured client data. This includes reproducing Capital Calls, Distributions, Expenses, Investments, Management Fees, Financial Statements, and Partners’ Capital to match client sources.
  • Resolving escalations related to data migration, historical accounting discrepancies, and client onboarding issues
  • Manage all aspects of customer onboarding for medium to high complexity new clients by managing timelines, setting clear customer expectations, and completing all compliance procedures pre go-live
  • Build strong client relationships and provide a white glove experience by going on-site, anticipating client needs, and using Carta app capabilities effectively
  • Identify process and quality improvements, assist with internal reviews, Quality Assurance, and train junior team members
  • Sharing accounting and onboarding specificities with upstream teams for efficient post go-live fund administration

The Team You\u2019ll Work With

Our implementation accounting team acts as the bridge between sales and long term account management for new fund clients. The team ensures whatever information our clients had before joining Carta is correctly migrated into our system. Ours is a team of folks who have mastery of accounting, exhibit a high degree of problem-solving, efficiency, and integrity as they leverage their subject-matter expertise to provide customers with a world-class onboarding experience.

About You

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of experience in an accounting role where you executed all aspects of end of quarter and year closes, preferably working within the Venture Capital Fund Administration environment
  • Strong accounting analysis skills with the ability to interpret a story through multiple years of unstructured data, and reproduce Financial Statements correctly
  • Ability to build strong client relationships through transparent and forthright communication. Able to manage multiple clients while hitting deadlines and providing white-glove service
  • Passionate about growing and advancing with Carta
  • Proven internal influencer having implemented and successfully managed both small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously

Salary

Carta’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, exceptional benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans. Our minimum cash compensation (salary + commission if applicable) range for this role is:

  • $102,000 - $120,000 in San Francisco, CA, Santa Clara, CA, and New York, NY
  • $96,900 - $114,000 in Seattle, WA

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the recruiter via email. As a company, we value fairness, helpfulness, transparency, leadership and build our teams around these values. Check out our careers page to get to know us better as you think about your next step at Carta.

Important Security Notice for Candidates

Our company has been targeted by individuals creating fake domains similar to ours to scam prospects and candidates. Please note that all official communications from us will come from an @carta.com domain. Be cautious of any requests for sensitive information or payments outside of our official channels. For more information about this type of scam, please review the guidelines provided by the Federal Trade Commission (FTC). If you encounter any suspicious activity, please report it immediately to

Awards and Acknowledgements

Companies and funds like Tribe and Pipe build their businesses on Carta. The company has been included on the Forbes World’s Best Cloud Companies, Fast Company\u2019s Most Innovative list, and Inc.’s Fastest-Growing Private Companies. We’ve also been recognized as a 2023 Built In Best Place to Work in the U.S., a Muse VIBE Award winner in the Vacation and Time Off category and certified as a Great Place to Work.

description:
Técnico de Imobilização Ortopédica - Rede Hospital Casa - CLT

Somos a Rede Hospital Casa, um dos maiores operadores médicos hospitalares independentes do estado do Rio de Janeiro. O ACOLHIMENTO COMO NOSSO JEITO DE CUIDAR está entre os nossos principais valores.

Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar como Técnico de Imobilização Ortopédica que seja proativo, cuidadoso, dedicado e que tenha atenção e amor com seus processos de trabalho.

Suas principais atividades serão:

  • Assumir o posto de serviço conforme escala, devidamente identificado, uniformizado e com aparência pessoal adequada;
  • Identificar corretamente o paciente antes de realizar o procedimento;
  • Preparar paciente para procedimentos de imobilização ortopédica;
  • Preparar material para confeccionar as imobilizações;
  • Preparar sala para pequenos procedimentos fora do centro cirúrgico, como pequenas suturas e anestesia local para manobras de redução manual, punções e infiltrações;
  • Observar o tipo de imobilização a confeccionar, as condições do paciente, seguindo orientações e prescrição médica;
  • Confeccionar imobilizações e aparelhos gessados nas salas de gesso e cirurgia;
  • Confeccionar imobilizações com material sintético, aparelhos gessados, goteiras gessadas, esparadrapagem, talas digitais (imobilização para os dedos), enfaixamento, tração cutânea, colar cervical, entre outros, conforme prescrição médica;
  • Retirar aparelhos de imobilização ortopédica, conforme prescrição médica;
  • Utilizar de forma adequada equipamentos como serra elétrica vibratória;
  • Realizar procedimentos específicos em imobilizações ortopédicas, como a abertura de janelas no aparelho gessado;
  • Manter sala de imobilização organizada;
  • Zelar pela limpeza da sala, bem como organização e preservação e guarda de materiais e equipamentos de uso na sua especialidade;
  • Auxiliar o médico ortopedista em procedimentos ortopédicos não cirúrgicos, como na instalação de trações esqueléticas e manobras de redução manual;
  • Realizar lançamento e registro em prontuário dos procedimentos realizados e materiais utilizados;
  • Promover orientações pertinentes e de conservação da imobilização aos pacientes;
  • Auxiliar a equipe multidisciplinar em imobilizações de pacientes vítimas de trauma ou que necessitem de restrição total de movimento;
  • Obedecer às normas técnicas da Sociedade Brasileira de Ortopedia e Traumatologia (SBOT), às normas internacionais para confecção de imobilização, normas regulamentadoras de Segurança do Trabalho e o Código de Ética Profissional;
  • Notificar a equipe de enfermagem toda e qualquer ocorrência administrativa;
  • Notificar a equipe de enfermagem toda ocorrência durante atendimento ao paciente;
  • Participar de treinamentos institucional e setorial quando solicitado sua participação;
  • Cumprir as normas e regulamentos da Instituição, bem como as rotinas operacionais da sua Unidade;
  • Respeitar e conhecer os instrumentos normativos do setor como instruções de trabalho.

Esperamos que você tenha:

  • Ensino médio completo com curso técnico em imobilização ortopédica.
  • Registro no conselho de Classe.
  • Desejável experiência anterior de 06 meses.
  • Noções básicas de Primeiros Socorros a pacientes vítimas de trauma, Higiene ocupacional, biossegurança e ergonomia, equipamentos e Materiais ortopédicos.
  • Noções de Ortopedia e Traumatologia.

Conheça os benefícios que oferecemos para você:

  • Refeição no Local;
  • Convênio Médico;
  • Convênio Odontológico;

description:
Card Authority and Disputes Administrator

Join to apply for the Card Authority and Disputes Administrator role at Paymentology .

At Paymentology , we’re redefining what’s possible in the payments space. As the first truly global issuer‑processor, we give banks and fintechs the technology and talent to launch and manage Mastercard and Visa cards at scale across more than 60 countries. Our advanced, multi‑cloud platform delivers real‑time data, unmatched scalability, and the flexibility of shared or dedicated processing instances. It's this global reach and innovation that sets us apart.

We’re looking for a Card Authority and Disputes Administrator to manage and process chargebacks, transaction disputes, and card authority operations across global card networks. This role ensures every case and authorisation exception is validated, documented, and resolved in line with regulatory and card scheme standards. You’ll play a key role in protecting clients and cardholders from financial loss while upholding Paymentology’s operational integrity, operating independently on assigned cases and prioritising workload against SLA and regulatory deadlines.

Responsibilities

  • Handle and process cardholder disputes involving authorised and unauthorised transactions.
  • Conduct detailed investigations using multiple internal systems and external partners.
  • Validate data accuracy and ensure all documentation meets compliance and network standards.
  • Determine appropriate actions and craft timely, accurate responses to networks within SLA and regulatory timelines.
  • Oversee card authority processes including transaction approvals, declines, and authorisation reviews.
  • Provide guidance to internal teams and clients on dispute outcomes, escalations, and card authorisation queries.
  • Maintain current knowledge of card scheme rules, dispute categories, and operational procedures.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives in dispute resolution, authorisation processes, and reporting accuracy.

Requirements

  • Strong understanding of Visa/Mastercard dispute and card authorisation processes and compliance standards.
  • Skilled in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Outlook, Word) and case management tools.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Analytical, customer‑centric, and detail‑oriented, with the ability to work to tight deadlines.
  • Able to coordinate with card network partners, client operations teams, and internal reconciliation staff to ensure compliance and customer satisfaction.
  • 2–4 years in dispute resolution, card operations, or financial customer service.

What You Can Look Forward To

At Paymentology , it’s not just about building great payment technology, it’s about building a company where people feel they belong and their work matters. You’ll be part of a diverse, global team that’s genuinely committed to making a positive impact through what we do. Whether you’re working across time zones or getting involved in initiatives that support local communities, you’ll find real purpose in your work and the freedom to grow in a supportive, forward‑thinking environment.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência na liderança de inspeção técnica de equipamentos de transmissão (transformadores, disjuntores, TC/TP, cabos, estruturas) e geração (turbinas, geradores, sistemas auxiliares, subestações).

  • Atuação em grandes projetos de infraestrutura energética, com foco em confiabilidade e desempenho dos ativos.
  • Experiência em tratamento de não conformidades, análise de causa, ações corretivas/preventivas e gestão de indicadores.

description:
Engenheiro de Projetos de Perfuração - Rio de Janeiro/RJ

Join to apply for the Engenheiro de Projetos de Perfuração - Rio de Janeiro/RJ role at Infotec Brasil

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Concepção de projeto de perfuração;
  • Análise e cadastro de insumos;
  • Análise e elaboração de resumo de ocorrências dos poços de correlação;
  • Elaboração ou avaliação de estudo de geopressões, geomecânica e estimativa de fechamento;
  • Assentar sapatas atendendo às normas de segurança e ao escopo do projeto;
  • Classificar a criticidade de poço;
  • Disponibilização dos insumos para projetos especializados e estimativa de duração e custos;
  • Preenchimento dos dados básicos no sistema de projetos e no de orçamentação;
  • Solicitação e análise crítica de estudos de geologia e caracterização biológica do leito marinho;
  • Solicitação e análise crítica de diagrama de restrições para operações em poços offshore;
  • Solicitação e análise crítica de documento declaratório de formações com potencial de fluxo;
  • Solicitação de estrutura analítica de projetos (EAP);
  • Solicitação de estudos especializados de perfuração de poços (projetos de revestimento, cabeça de poço, fluidos, BHA, direcional, perfilagem, alargamento e testemunhagem);
  • Solicitação e análise crítica de riser analysis e WSOG;
  • Solicitação de estimativa de duração probabilística da intervenção;
  • Condução de reunião de pré-projeto, de GEP (Grupo de Empreendimento de Poço) de planejamento, GEP de execução e de planejamento integrado de poço;
  • Participação nas reuniões operacionais, de gestão de mudança de seus poços, de CCAPE e CCAPD dos poços por ele projetados e dos eventos de lições aprendidas;
  • Elaboração dos documentos resultantes do projeto de perfuração (dados básicos, resumo executivo de FEL, cronograma executivo de perfuração e book de projetos);
  • Elaboração de documentos para órgãos externos (parceria, ANP e demais órgãos);
  • Preencher o checklist de perfuração em sistema;
  • Suporte ao coordenador de GEP durante toda a execução e passagem de serviço do poço;
  • Participação nas reuniões do poço projetado (como análises de risco e gestão de mudança);
  • Elaboração de análise preliminar de riscos, conforme padrões e normas;
  • Avaliação de sondas quanto otimização a segurança operacional contemplando, mas não limitado aos seguintes itens (Capacidade de corte do BOP, disponibilidade de EDS’s, avaliação do sistema de compensação e de posicionamento dinâmico da unidade e dos obstáculos na locação);
  • Elaboração de gestões de mudança de projeto;
  • Suportar a elaboração do documento de passagem de serviço dos poços (Handover);
  • Suportar a elaboração das análises de envelope operacional e conjunto solidários de barreiras.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação: Curso de Nível Superior em Engenharia em instituição reconhecida pelo Ministério da Educação (MEC) ou outro órgão do governo federal destinado a esse fim, com registro no respectivo Conselho de Classe.
  • Experiência: Em projeto e/ou execução de perfuração de poços de petróleo offshore.
  • Conhecimentos Técnicos: Competência de Dados — tratamento, transferência, coleta, organização, agrupamento, noções de análise estatística, árvore de decisão; Pacote Office: Word, Excel, Power Point; Power BI: Noções, filtros, organização dos dados, pesquisa. Operação básica com dados; Noções de projeto de poço marítimo; Noções de construção de poço direcional, vertical e horizontal como operador e como projetista: premissas básicas de projetos, limitações e boas práticas em projetos e execução; Noções de equipamentos de sondas de perfuração; Noções de conceitos básicos de perfuração direcional; Conhecimento de ferramentas direcionais: motores de fundo, rotary steerable e turbinas de perfuração (seleção, limites operacionais, vantagens e desvantagens e operação); Noções de ferramentas de mapeamento de poço: MWD, GWD, Gyro; Noções de ferramentas de perfilagem: LWD e ferramentas a cabo. Limites e operação (poço aberto e poço revestido); Influência do direcional nas descidas a cabo por gravidade; Noções de projeto de BHA: tubulares, alargadores, escareadores, percussores de perfuração; Noções de operação e projeto utilizando sistemas de alargamento (alargadores, ferramentas de eliminação de offset broca x alargador em manobra única, estabilização no poço alargado etc.); Noções de simulação: torque e drag, hidráulica de poço e desgaste de revestimento; Noções de brocas de perfuração: seleção e cálculo de hidráulica; Noções de hidráulica de poço: correlação entre limpeza de poço e geometria de trajetória; Noções de segurança de poço e análise anticolisão entre poços; Noções de geologia e geodésia; Noções de orçamentação de poços; Noções de operação e projeto de testemunhagem; Noções de operações e projeto de canhoneio; Noções de operações e projeto de MPD; Noções básicas dos tipos de completação (contenção de areia, completações simples e inteligentes, etc.); Noções básicas sobre cimentação, recimentação e correção da cimentação; Aplicação do canhoneio nos diferentes tipos de completação (cargas e densidades); Noções básicas de workover e de abandono; Noções básicas de caracterização de reservatório (geologia, geofísica e avaliação de reservatórios); Idiomas: Português (Brasil) - escrita e oral – nível fluente; Inglês técnico - escrita e oral - nível intermediário; Possuir noções básicas de construção de poços marítimos e dos equipamentos e sistemas de unidades de perfuração marítima; Desejáveis noções básicas em brocas, perfuração direcional, MPD, integridade de poços, estabilidade geomecânica de poços, fundações de poços, fluidos de perfuração, cimentação e equipamentos que compõem a estrutura de poços (cabeça de poço, revestimentos etc).

Implementations Project Manager, Fund Admin

The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta we create owners and make private markets liquid.

We live in a world where some people live on the equity stack and enjoy exponential wealth growth and preferential tax treatment; others live on the debt stack and may work their entire lives for a company and retire only with the cash they’ve managed to save from their paychecks. Our contribution to solving the wealth inequality problem is moving people from the debt stack (payroll) to the equity stack. By making it as easy to issue equity to employees as it is to put them on payroll, we can create more owners.

At Carta, we are helpful, transparent, fair, and kind. We are relentless executors, unconventional thinkers, and masters of our craft.

To learn more, here is what one of our investors wrote about leading our Series F.

The Problems You’ll Solve

As an Implementations Project Manager, you will focus efforts on supporting new Investor Services customers in their journey into Carta services. You will drive operational excellence within our fast‑growing Investor Services business by coordinating, facilitating and managing on‑boarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline.

The Impact You’ll Have

You’ll play a critical role in the transformation of the financial services industry through partnering with our new clients and helping them implement our software. In this role you will be responsible for interacting with a fund’s back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate data to both the client and internal stakeholders.

About You

From sale close, to implementation, and continued customer success, the ideal Implementations Project Manager will exhibit excellent communication skills, a high degree of problem‑solving, velocity, embracing change and will constantly seek ways to better their process to provide customers with a world‑class on‑boarding experience.

  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously
  • Passionate, tactical, and direct, with an ambitious attitude and a proven history to go above and beyond baseline requirements

title: Art Lead - NFL Universe Football
description:
Art Lead - NFL Universe Football

Join to apply for the Art Lead - NFL Universe Football role at Voldex.

Voldex is a leading gaming company focused on Roblox, the most exciting ecosystem in gaming today. We are home to several of Roblox’s top games, including Brookhaven, Driving Empire, and NFL Universe Football. With over 145 million monthly active players across our games, we are the #1 Roblox developer by audience size. Founded in 2015, we have since grown to 75+ full‑time remote team members across the globe.

Our top games include:

  • Brookhaven, #1 Roleplay game on Roblox and the most popular game on the Roblox platform
  • Driving Empire, the #1 driving game on Roblox where we’ve brought real cars into the game in partnership with automakers
  • NFL Universe Football, the #1 American football game and top grossing sports game on Roblox

Responsibilities

  • Contribute a consistent allocation of time to building out 3D art assets for the game
  • Address artistic challenges, manage art‑team workloads, and ensure art assets are delivered on time, efficiently, and within the technical performance budget
  • Lead, manage, and mentor a small team of artists, providing clear direction, constructive feedback, and fostering a positive, creative work environment
  • Lead game’s style and art direction
  • Supervise both 2D, 3D, and render artists
  • Develop and maintain art‑production pipelines, processes, and documentation to ensure efficient asset creation and implementation
  • Review and provide feedback on the team’s work, ensuring assets meet quality standards and align with the artistic vision and technical requirements of the project

Requirements

  • A deep understanding of asset performance metrics and methodologies on the Roblox platform
  • High proficiency in Roblox Studio and substantial experience on the Roblox platform
  • 1‑3 years of experience working in a professional studio environment or a mixture of Roblox creator experience that demonstrates equivalent expertise and leadership
  • Highly organized and process oriented, needs to be able to think in scale and systems to help level up the Art team

Nice to Have

  • Experience creating art assets under performance constraints while maintaining a clear, visually appealing style
  • Experience collaborating with game designers and product teams to understand art request details and flag risks or needs for additional information
  • Proven ability to own a game’s art direction and mentor a team of artists toward a consistent execution of that style or direction
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage and mentor a diverse team of artists
  • Familiarity with project management tools such as Monday.com, Asana, JIRA, or similar applications
  • Familiar with or a fan of American Football

Tech Stack

  • Roblox Studio
  • Photoshop / GIMP / Substance Painter
  • Maya
  • Blender

Location

  • Remote
  • Travel - 2 to 3x / year (onboarding, RDC + possible team meet‑ups)
  • Time Zone – must be willing to work EST/PST hours
  • Ideal Hiring Regions: Canada, UK, LATAM

Voldex is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation – above‑market salary + profit sharing + stock options
  • Retirement benefits – company contribution to your retirement plan (401k, RRSP, Pension), in Canada, UK and USA!
  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits – depending on the country, there may be additional benefits (Life, ADD, etc…) such as Canada, UK and USA.
  • Flexible PTO – vacations + Federal / Bank Holidays
  • Remote First – we have always been remote and will remain that way including work from home/anywhere
  • In‑person get‑togethers, virtual company‑wide game events, Robux allowances, and so much more!
  • Professional Development – reimburse the costs of courses, materials, and anything to help further your training and growth
  • Work with awesome people and impact millions of daily players

Additional Information

  • Driving Empire & Nascar: Brand Partnership
  • Voldex & NFL: Brand Partnership
  • Our partners at Andreessen Horowitz share why they’ve invested in Voldex

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Nosso ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Job Family Group: Corporate Relations

Worker Type: Regular

Posting Start Date: December 9, 2025

Business Unit: CoS and Corporate Relations

Experience Level: Experienced Professionals

What’s the role

You will be a key player in our Societal Impact and Energy Transition program team in Shell Brasil’s Corporate Relations team. One of our objectives is to create a positive presence and legacy in the communities and countries in which we operate and to be a trusted and responsible neighbour. We do this by engaging with our communities, identifying and mitigating the social impacts of our operations, and delivering benefits through social investment. You will be working closely with the Societal Impact and Energy Transition Program Manager and business colleagues in the country, as well as the regional and global Social Performance Centre of Excellence in Shell.

What you’ll be doing

  • Developing and implementing a robust social investment strategy for Shell in Brazil that is aligned with our business objectives in-country, Shell’s Group social investment strategy and requirements, and the social context of our communities
  • Identifying and designing meaningful social investment programmes in line with the strategy
  • Selecting and managing delivery partners to help us implement our social investment programmes
  • Driving implementation of the social investment programmes, with clear oversight and regular review of performance against goals and targets
  • Developing and executing monitoring, evaluation, and learning plans for our social investment programmes, jointly with our delivery partners
  • Undertaking social baseline and evaluation studies as needed to help inform and continuously improve social investment programmes
  • Developing and implementing impact-led communication plans for internal and external stakeholders
  • Engaging leaders to create a shared vision and internal alignment on Shell Brazil social investment objectives and activities
  • Representing Shell externally and engaging with a broad range of stakeholders including communities, government, joint venture partners, civil society organisations, among others
  • Proactively identifying and managing risks to the social investment programmes, and identifying continuous improvement opportunities to ensure the programmes remain externally relevant, impactful, and efficient
  • Developing and coordinating the disaster response plans for supporting communities where needed
  • Ensuring compliance with Shell’s business principles, ethics, and compliance standards
  • Ensuring budget and activity planning and tracking progress, and compliance with Shell’s global reporting requirements for social investment spend and outcomes

What you bring

  • Must have legal authorization to work in Brazil on a full‑time basis for anyone other than the current employer.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field
  • 15+ years of experience with qualifications relevant to social development
  • Significant experience and proven track record in designing and delivering social development programmes, in particular related to STEM skills, enterprise development, and livelihood programmes
  • Experience working with corporates in designing and delivering social programmes with a good understanding of business processes and influencing senior business leaders
  • Extensive external network in the development sector to help create strong collaborations and partnerships
  • Experience managing external delivery partners
  • Experience in developing monitoring, evaluation, and learning frameworks; measuring and reporting impacts
  • Strategic and critical thinking skills to design and develop new programmes, and the ability to troubleshoot and solve problems
  • Strong communication (written and verbal), presentation, and facilitation skills; business fluency in English is a minimum requirement
  • Excellent collaboration, stakeholder influencing, and management skills across organizational boundaries and different levels of seniority, without direct authority
  • Ability to uphold high‑quality standards, anticipate and manage risks
  • Excellent project/programme management skills
  • Solid team leadership skills
  • Learner Mindset – role model curiosity and reflection, and encourage people to learn from mistakes and successes
  • Maximise performance – integrate and collaborate across boundaries to maximise commercial value for the organisation as a whole

What we offer

You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.

  • Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
  • Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
  • Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
  • Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
  • Achieve your balance in a values‑led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
  • Benefit from flexible working hours, and the possibility of remote/mobile working.
  • Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance‑related salary increase – our pay and benefits packages are considered to be among the best in the world.
  • Take advantage of paid parental leave, including for non‑birthing parents.
  • Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
  • Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and international teams.
  • Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

Shell is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

description:
Static Mechanical Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package

Full relocation to Saudi Arabia – permanent full-time Expat Relocation Package.

Job Overview: We are seeking a Plant Corrosion Engineer to join the Riyas Engineering Division (RNGLFD) which is part of the Riyas NGL Fractionation Dept (RNGLFD).

RNGLFD is responsible for two trains, each designed to process 255 MBOD (242.25 MBCD). Each train will include fractionation units, C3 & C4 treatment, C3 & C4 dehydration and propane refrigeration. The common facilities will include feed and product surge storage, chemicals storage and utilities including, but not limited to, steam and condensate recovery systems, utility water, plant, instrument air and nitrogen systems, machinery cooling water, drainage and flare systems. Some of the systems (e.g., steam headers, flare headers, product storage) have been pre-invested for the future train.

Your primary role will be to implement, support and continually improve RNGLFP inspection corrosion management programs and provide consolatory advice in materials, ensuring cost effective material selection and corrosion mitigation strategies, which will ensure mechanical integrity of the materials, applied on all plant assets including equipment and piping through their life cycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Implement corrosion management program and on-stream monitoring and Conduct risk-based inspection based on API-580 methodology.
  • Review and approve recommended solutions for coating failures and cathodic protection and participate in HAZOP review sessions and ensure that all issues are addressed.
  • Manage water treatment program and recommend solutions to overcome challenges and review design packages and validate materials selection based on current code and standards.
  • Validate corrosion controls corrosion controls, corrosion (CCD), corrosion loops and corrosion damage mechanisms frequently.
  • Assess FEED composition changes and approve recommended solution to assure assets integrity.
  • Develop scope and description of technology items, and lead field implementation.
  • Develop and transfer knowledge about use of coating, Cathodic protection (CP), corrosion inhibitors and other corrosion controls and best practices.
  • Extract data and draw conclusions from Corrosion Monitoring Technologies, and troubleshoot corrosion problems and address root causes.
  • Perform the regular review and update on the plants Integrity Operating Windows (IOW) and Corrosion loops drawings shall be updated by adding emerging damage mechanisms or removing damage mechanisms because of plant upgrades.
  • Adjust and modify inspection practices and programs shall be reflected based on such modifications and perform special studies in corrosion control. Evaluates data as to scope, impact and long-range cost effectiveness on existing and new projects.
  • Review operations and monitoring activities to identify needed system modifications or procedural changes associated with corrosion control with conduct corrosion mitigation and integrity review to optimize the inspection and corrosion programs and maintain assets integrity.

Qualification Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, preferably in mechanical engineer.
  • 15 years' experience processing in Oil/Gas Industry.
  • Demonstrate experience in material science and metrology, different NDT technology and their applications and knowledge in engineering aspect of welding.
  • Strong Knowledge of international standards and codes NACE, ASME, API and ASTM especially inspection and corrosion standards such as API-571, API-580, API-570 and API-510.
  • Valid NACE Specialist Certification or NACE Senior Corrosion Technologist or combination of NACE Corrosion Technologist, API-571 and NACE CP level II.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
Job Duties

You’ll own the delivery lifecycle end-to-end—from architecture and design to production reliability, technical mentorship, and stakeholder alignment. We’re looking for someone who can turn complex requirements into secure, scalable, high-quality software — and help the team grow in the process.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own architecture and design: create system diagrams, define functional and non-functional requirements (such as scalability, reliability, security and cost), and set integration standards.
  • Build and deliver using our technology stack (see below) with focus on quality, performance, and observability.
  • Lead initiatives: break down roadmaps, manage small to medium-sized projects, remove blockers, and ensure on-time delivery.
  • Plan and prioritize: create execution plans, estimate effort, manage risks, and clearly communicate progress to stakeholders.
  • Drive engineering excellence: enforce automated testing (unit, integration, e2e), deep code reviews, branch and release standards, and code quality.
  • Document for scale: maintain architecture documents, ADRs, operational guides, and runbooks, ensuring traceability and clarity within agile processes and tools.
  • Client interaction: attend remote and in-person meetings, capture requirements, discuss trade-offs, and present solutions clearly.
  • Mentor others: guide mid-level and junior developers, share best practices, lead tech talks, and promote a learning culture.
  • Partner management: coordinate third parties, validate deliverables, and ensure alignment with project goals.
  • Ensure production quality: validate system integrations, instrument logs, metrics, and tracing, define basic SLOs, and participate in post-mortems.
  • Continuous learning: explore new technologies, identify process improvements, and propose architectural enhancements.
  • Administrative support: handle operational requests and be available for national or international travel when required.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or related field.
  • Experience: 7+ years of professional experience, including technical leadership on complex projects.
  • Stack: Backend (Java, Python and .Net Core), Frontend (Angular), Node.js, SQL, strong background in REST API development, microservices and event-driven architectures.
  • Cloud: Hands-on experience with AWS or Azure, IAM (Identity and Access Management), storage, managed services and observability.
  • Quality & DevOps: Test automation, Git, Gitflow, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, semantic versioning and promotion across environments.
  • Security & Reliability: Familiarity with OWASP Top 10, secret management, least privilege, basic hardening, and observability (logs, metrics, tracing).
  • Language: Advanced English (written and spoken, client-facing).
  • Profile: Proactive, system thinker, fluent with modern frameworks and best practices in development, testing, and cloud operations.

Nice to have:

  • Postgraduate or Master’s degree.
  • Spanish proficiency.
  • IaC (Terraform) and platform engineering principles.
  • Multi-cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP) and cost/performance optimization.
  • Exposure to performance tuning, caching, messaging/queue systems (e.g., Kafka), and feature flag management.

O Atacadão marca presença no ambiente digital por meio do seu e-commerce, com um próprio canal de vendas online mais direcionado a transformadores, comerciantes e empreendedores de pequenas, médias e grandes empresas, pela possibilidade de adquirir volumes maiores de itens, parcerias com aplicativos de entrega que atendem ao consumidor final, e também o Meu Atacadão, aplicativo que permite que os clientes encontrem ofertas diferenciadas enquanto fazem suas compras nas lojas físicas.

Tem como pilares de sustentabilidade o combate à fome e às desigualdades, a diversidade e inclusão e a proteção ao planeta e biodiversidade.

Join to apply for the AI/ML Engineer Tech Lead Manager role at Shape Digital

We are looking for a AI/ML Engineer Tech Lead Manager to act as one of the key leaders within our Data Science discipline. This role combines team management, hands‑on technical contribution and strong product partnership to ensure the delivery of high‑quality, scalable and business‑driven AI solutions.

The Tech Lead Manager will guide a team of Data Scientists, support planning and prioritization across initiatives and collaborate closely with Product and Engineering to drive clarity, alignment and iterative value delivery. This person will remain technically involved, contributing to experimentation, design decisions, and the development of robust end‑to‑end solutions while helping elevate standards and practices across the discipline. It’s also important to stay connected to emerging trends in AI and modern ML technologies.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and support Data Scientists through coaching, feedback and structured team rituals.
  • Cultivate a challenging and inspiring environment that supports the company to retain, attract and hire people who are talented and better than you.
  • Ensure clear planning, prioritization and execution across multiple streams.
  • Contribute to product and technical roadmaps, helping shape priorities and delivery plans.
  • Identify opportunities for AI solutions and work with domain experts to translate real problems.
  • Contribute hands‑on to model exploration, experimentation, architecture decisions and solution design.
  • Maintain high engineering and scientific standards: reproducibility, documentation, evaluation and deployment readiness.
  • Guide end‑to‑end solution development, ensuring scalability, maintainability and operational excellence.
  • Collaborate with other leaders to evolve shared frameworks, processes and best practices.
  • Promote a culture of iteration, incremental value delivery and continuous improvement.
  • Stay up to date with modern ML and AI trends, especially around LLMs and emerging technologies.
  • Foster internal knowledge sharing and contribute to the growth of the technical community.
  • Lead the elaboration of research papers, technical publications and patent applications derived from the team's innovative AI methods and solutions, while safeguarding intellectual property.

Requirements

  • Degree in a STEM field (Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, etc.).
  • Experience leading Data Science teams or mentoring senior‑level Data Scientists.
  • Strong hands‑on expertise in AI, Machine Learning, Python and SQL.
  • Solid knowledge of ML frameworks such as Scikit‑Learn, TensorFlow, Keras, or PyTorch.
  • Proven experience designing, building and deploying ML solutions in production.
  • Excellent communication skills for engaging with technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
  • Strong problem solver with ability to manage and lead the team to push solution & progress.
  • Experience working collaboratively with Product and Engineering organizations.
  • English proficiency required.

Differentials

  • Experience in the industrial or manufacturing sector.
  • Hands‑on experience with LLM‑based solutions.
  • Experience with cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP).

  • Flexible Hours: Work at the best time for you and have a better quality of life.

Title

Perinatal Sonographer

About the Role

We seek a dedicated professional with expertise in high-risk obstetric imaging to support the Maternal Fetal Medicine/Perinatology department at Howard University. The full‑time position offers a four‑day work week and focuses on daily sonographic laboratory operations, equipment maintenance, and continuous quality assessment of imaging services.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform all requested sonographic examinations as ordered, including 1st to 3rd trimester, limited, transvaginal exams, and biophysical profiles.
  • Explain procedures, prepare patients, and support families in a compassionate manner.
  • Verify accuracy of requisitions, gather pertinent history, and provide summary findings to supervising physicians.
  • Assist perinatologists with invasive procedures such as amniocentesis.
  • Maintain equipment, report failures, and perform daily pre‑visit planning.
  • Prepare preliminary reports on the Viewpoint system in accordance with FPP and billing policies.
  • Implement infection control, safety, and HIPAA compliance; protect PHI.
  • Collaborate with physicians, nurses, genetic counselors, and other staff to ensure comprehensive patient care.
  • Serve as communication liaison and coordinate urgent patient needs.
  • Participate in continuing education and critical‑thinking activities.

description:
Já pensou em fazer parte do crescimento da maior provedora de produtos e serviços para pacientes com doença renal em todo o mundo? Todas as nossas ações convergem para um só objetivo: promover a saúde e o bem-estar do paciente. Queremos criar um futuro que vale a pena viver!
QUEM SOMOS:
A Fresenius Medical Care (FME) tem como propósito fundamental melhorar a vida dos pacientes com doença renal crônica (DRC), oferecendo-lhes um serviço integral, caracterizado pela mais alta tecnologia para o tratamento de diálise e o apoio permanente de uma equipe especializada, profissional e comprometida com a saúde do paciente.
Graças a este compromisso, a Fresenius Medical Care tornou-se a maior provedora mundial de produtos e serviços para pacientes com doença renal crônica, uma doença que afeta a mais de 3,2 milhões de pessoas em todo o mundo. Provemos serviços de diálise por meio de mais de 3.928 clínicas de diálise em todos os continentes, atendendo a mais de 333.331 pacientes.
Descrição :
Responsável por garantir o bom estado geral do paciente renal crônico em tratamento dialítico, colaborando na resolução de problemas psicológicos, trabalhando a autonomia e engajamento do paciente, respeitando sua individualidade.
Garantir a aderência do paciente renal ao tratamento dialítico, analisando e intervindo nas situações de não aderência, assim como nas situações de faltas às sessões de diálise.

  • O que você irá realizar
  • Entrevistar os pacientes novos na unidade, registrando os dados no prontuário do paciente ou meio eletrônico (somente serão registradas informações que tenham relevância ao tratamento dialítico);
  • Acompanhar o estado psicológico do paciente através de atendimento aos pacientes em diálise periodicamente, avaliando a pertinência de intervenções específicas e assistindo individualmente aqueles que necessitem;
  • Favorecer um ambiente adequado de diálise, a fim de propiciar a aderência do paciente ao tratamento, tornando o tempo de diálise em momento produtivo;
  • Trabalhar visando à integração entre pacientes;
  • Orientar os pacientes e familiares proporcionando o acesso envolvimento ao seu tratamento, por meio da educação continuada e juntamente equipe multidisciplinar;
  • Promover a integração da equipe multidisciplinar x pacientes e um apoio para as dificuldades encontradas no lidar com o paciente renal crônico através da realização de reuniões com a equipe de saúde;
  • Promover reuniões periódicas com pacientes, objetivando esclarecer dúvidas e orienta-los quanto às implicações emocionais e comportamentais no tratamento dialítico;
  • Analisar mensalmente relatórios de faltas de pacientes as sessões de diálise e realizar plano de ação visando melhorar a aderência do paciente renal a sessão;
  • Solicitar a presença de pacientes/familiares em eventos sociais auxiliando na promoção destes eventos juntamente com serviço Social;
  • Representar a ouvidoria do paciente junto à Unidade de Diálise e encaminhar reclamações/solicitações pertinentes aos setores competentes;
  • Garantir o registro das informações psicológicas do paciente através da confecção das evoluções periódicas no prontuário do paciente ou me meio eletrônico;
  • Participar de processos institucionais, programas e/ou projetos corporativos estabelecendo um relacionamento adequado com os clientes externos e internos;
  • Participar ativamente das reuniões técnicas, administrativas e multidisciplinares (Reuniões de Qualidade, PCPIEA, etc) da unidade visando melhoria continua dos resultados da unidade;
  • Participar de reuniões e resultados clínicos da unidade, visando à elaboração de plano de ação para situações (Relatório de faltas às sessões, problemas relacionados à não aderência, e outros);
  • Garantir a autorização para atuar na empresa através do cumprimento das obrigações legais mediante ao Conselho Regional de Psicologia assim como cumprir e fazer cumprir o código de ética e atendimento aos requisitos legais.
  • Esperamos que você tenha
  • Ensino Superior completo em Psicologia;
  • CRP ativo e regular;
  • Experiência prévia com atendimento clínico em Nefrologia;
  • Desejável especialização em Psicologia Clínica;
  • Disponibilidade para cumprir 30 horas semanais e/ou 44 horas semanais
  • Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro
  • Oferecemos: Salário e Benefícios compatíveis ao mercado.

Na Fresenius oferecemos oportunidades iguais para todos os profissionais qualificados, independentemente de gênero, raça, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica; proporcionando respeito mútuo, ambiente saudável e motivador a todos.

description:
Process Engineer - Rio at Hanwha Ocean

Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, RJ, BR

Requisition ID: 1286

Overview

Hanwha Ocean is undergoing a transformative journey, evolving from a traditional shipbuilder to an Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Installation, and Operation (EPCI(O)) solution provider, offering products such as FPSO, FLNG, Offshore Renewables and other Floating Production Units. The Energy Plant Unit is proud to announce the establishment of new Global Business Centers, marking a significant milestone toward becoming a project‑centric and client‑driven organization.

Position Overview

The Process Engineer leads and controls process engineering activities. The Principal Process Engineer performs checks and reviews all data requested by the Client for approval, provides assessments on the performance of engineers, and ensures that engineering work and deliverables in the process discipline are accurate and correct to code, standards, and project specifications. The role may require frequent travel to the US, Europe, and Asia.

Key Responsibilities

  • Understand project requirements, scope of work, and project schedule.
  • Supervise Senior and Junior Process Engineers from project start to finish.
  • Ensure all engineering documents are prepared and developed in accordance with relevant design codes, standards, and client specifications.
  • Provide engineering expertise and support or report to the Manager of Process to ensure engineering progress meets timelines.
  • Ensure process and utility systems are optimized, efficient, safe, and environmentally compliant.

Assist in Project in Bidding or FEED Stage

  • Provide engineering review and support for bid proposals, including estimate of man‑hour and cost.
  • Conduct feasibility studies and FEED verification.

Process Engineering

  • Develop process calculations, studies, and deliverables.
  • Review process simulation and results, including heat and material balances, for accuracy of calculations.
  • Review all process engineering packages and deliverables (Sizing, Calculation, Report, PFD, PID, etc.).

Participation in Various Workshops

  • Chair HAZOP, Vendor HAZOP, HAZID, SIL, Design Review, and others.
  • Lead engineers to close out comments/punches/recommendations from HAZOP, Vendor HAZOP, HAZID, SIL, Design Review, etc.
  • Manage and report status of comments/recommendations.

Control 3rd Party and Sub‑Contractor

  • For special process study, contract, and selection through technical evaluation of 3rd party.
  • Manage 3rd Party work scope and review, comment, and approve 3rd Party output.
  • Control subcontractor performance and check quality of diagrams from subcontractor.

Participation and Support for Commissioning and Startup

  • Develop/review relevant philosophies and procedures.
  • Provide engineering support for construction, commissioning, and operation teams.

Management of Engineering

  • Ensure that process engineering output aligns with project objectives, schedule, and budget.
  • Generate regular progress reports.
  • Report engineering outstanding and concerns to the Discipline Manager with technical summaries of outstanding issues.

Problem Solving and Addressing Engineering Concerns

  • Provide engineering expertise for decision making to resolve process‑related issues.
  • Address engineering punches and comments.

Coordination and Communication

  • Lead engineering meetings with client, engineering subcontractor, and generate MOM.
  • Coordinate with detailed engineering consultants or client, vendors, and subcontractors.
  • Manage interface with all relevant disciplines to get necessary information for process engineering or to provide data to other disciplines.
  • Raise technical queries, RFIs, and others to obtain necessary information/Client approval.
  • Provide clarification/answer to Client’s request.

Monitoring and Mentoring

  • Teach, instruct, and guide less experienced Process Engineers.

Qualifications

  • At least a Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Petroleum or Chemical Engineering.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) or equivalent certification is a plus.
  • Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in process engineering in the offshore oil and gas industry.
  • Extensive knowledge of process engineering practices, principles, industry codes and standards, and an understanding of scientific methods of problem‑solving.
  • Proven track record of success in developing and performing Topsides Process Conceptual / Feasibility Studies during pre‑FEED/FEED or tender stage; prior experience with FPSO or FLNG design development and/or engineering project delivery (e.g., at a top‑tier FPSO contractor) is preferred.
  • Strong understanding of offshore industry terminology, concepts, and practices.
  • Knowledge of class rule, recognized code, standard, and skill of process engineering tools such as Aspen HYSYS, Flarenet, Pipe‑net or equivalent, and ability to interpret results of process simulation.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • Ability to work effectively independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team, with strong attention to detail and accuracy; ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Fluency in English.

Mid‑Senior level

Full‑time

Requisitos

  • Organização, disciplina, determinação e constância
  • Gostar de trabalhar com venda externa e por telefone

Benefícios

  • ASSISTÊNCIA FUNERAL
  • SEGURO DE VIDA ACIDENTES PESSOAIS

Observações

Oferecemos formação profissional em nossa Escola de Vendas por um período de 60 dias . Durante esse período, você será contratado como Promotor de Vendas com uma carga horária diária de 6 horas . Uma vez aprovado após o período de formação, será promovido a Vendedor Júnior estando apto para se tornar um vendedor de sucesso e será alocado na unidade mais próxima a sua residência, com carga horária diária de trabalho normal .

Pacifica Continental is an international recruitment consultancy that provides various services focused on talent acquisition to impact companies’ businesses worldwide. We offer a young and dynamic environment and are result-oriented, with the main goal of delivering outstanding solutions to our clients.

Our customized solutions and consultative approach ensure we select the best talent in the market. Our operations span over 50 countries and more than 250 cities globally.

Our DNA

  • Ambition - Guided by excellence, we strive for progress, not perfection;

Position overview:

As a Financial Specialist, you will play a key role within the company, overseeing various financial activities and contributing significantly to its financial health and efficiency.

  • Monitor and manage cash flows for assigned offices.

  • Define and monitor goals for teams and individuals to improve performance, aligning with costs.

  • Analyze accounting documents and link them to financial analyses for insights and improvements.
  • Prepare and present results reports and conduct weekly cash management reviews for decision-making support.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, or related fields.
  • Proven experience as a Financial Analyst or similar role, preferably in a multicultural environment.
  • Advanced Excel skills.
  • Intermediate knowledge of data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI) is a plus.
  • Fluent in English; Spanish is a plus.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and attention to detail skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for effective collaboration.
  • Motivation to work in a multicultural environment.
  • Ability to handle confidential information responsibly.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary.
  • Performance bonus.
  • Meal and grocery vouchers.
  • Gympass membership.
  • Health and Dental Insurance (SulAmérica Saúde).
  • Life Insurance.
  • Transportation voucher.
  • Home office tools, including a notebook and mobile, upon request.
  • Hybrid work model.

Apply now and join our team to contribute to our global growth story!

Descrição da oportunidade

Sabemos que carreiras podem ser tão diferentes quanto as próprias pessoas. Por isso, na EY, você terá a liberdade, as ferramentas e as condições para se desenvolver e construir uma carreira tão única quanto você.

Em Impostos, estamos construindo um mundo de negócios melhor apoiando organizações a prosperar em uma era de mudanças rápidas. Oferecemos serviços em todas as disciplinas tributárias e combinamos nosso conhecimento e experiência com as pessoas e as melhores plataformas de tecnologia; e isso nos torna um parceiro ideal para as necessidades relacionadas a impostos sobre transações, impostos internacionais e questões fiscais relacionadas a pessoas, conformidade e relatórios, entre outros.

Oportunidade disponível para atuação híbrida no escritório do Rio de Janeiro.

Qual será o seu papel nesse propósito?

Como uma pessoa assessora sênior de impostos diretos, você será parte de Tax atuando em vários projetos globais e locais na área de Global Compliance and Reporting (GCR), ajudando grandes empresas a administrar e reduzir os riscos de suas operações, e assumindo as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Orientar a equipe na gestão de riscos e oportunidades que envolvam apuração de tributos diretos Imposto de Renda de Pessoas Jurídicas (IRPJ) e Contribuição Social sobre o Lucro Líquido (CSLL);
  • Auxiliar as equipes de auditoria na revisão dos cálculos e identificação de riscos / exposições;
  • Atuar na revisão e preparação da ECF (Escrituração Contábil Fiscal) e ECD (Escrituração Contábil Digital);
  • Desenvolver as pessoas, por meio da delegação efetiva de tarefas e fornecimento de orientação à equipe, fornecendo feedback e treinamento com relação ao desempenho;
  • Direcionar o trabalho de campo, gerenciar o desempenho da equipe e manter a liderança atualizada sobre os trabalhos, documentando as áreas de maior risco;
  • Desenvolver constantemente a sua compreensão das tendências e processos atuais do mercado e compartilhar o seu conhecimento para desenvolver a equipe;
  • Auxiliar as equipes de auditoria na revisão dos cálculos e identificação de riscos / exposições;
  • Realizar a revisão e preparação do imposto diferido e respectivas projeções de acordo com as normas ASC 740 e IAS 12, bem como Tax Provision e reconciliação da alíquota efetiva;
  • Atuar como especialista em várias equipes de atendimento ao cliente, participando de projetos na área de Business Tax Advisory;
  • Prestar consultoria na gestão de riscos e oportunidades que envolvam apuração de tributos diretos.

Se você possui os requisitos abaixo, essa oportunidade pode ser sua:

  • Experiência consistente em projetos que envolvam apuração de impostos diretos, desenvolvendo estratégias de planejamento tributário alinhadas às necessidades globais de cada cliente;
  • Profundo conhecimento em impostos diretos (IRPJ e CSLL – Lucro real e lucro resumindo) e na preparação/revisão de ECF e ECD;
  • Graduação em Administração, Direito ou Contabilidade.

Poderá ser um diferencial, caso você tenha os seguintes requisitos:

  • Inglês – nível intermediário.

5x2 - segunda à sexta de 08h às 17h | Híbrido - Escritório Passeio, Rio de Janeiro

Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro e alguns testes. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!

Entrevista com o gestor: Esse é o momento de nos aprofundarmos na sua trajetória e compreender melhor o seu alinhamento com a nossa companhia.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for digital paid media advertising formats on Meta, TikTok, and other channels. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world‑building assets. You’re likely a Creative Strategist by trade with a background in Design, Video Editing, or Performance Marketing. You are hyper‑focused on paid media performance and developing advertisements that sell products and services.

You’ll work on our Performance Creative service—our AI‑powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients that want to work with us on the following:

  • Expertise: Engage us for our expertise in creative strategy, which includes assessing the efficacy of their ad hooks, ad bodies, and general creative direction. You will have a clear perspective on how to improve this over time.

  • Sales: Deliver game‑changing creative ads that sell their products and services better than anyone else.

  • Diversity: Increase the creative diversity of their ad program through the use of multiple ad formats: statics, motion, video, UGC, AI.

  • Volume: Increase the volume of their performance creative program by delivering upwards of 50‑100 new ads per month with the intention of scaling that as needed.

This role is for individuals who want to be at the forefront of digital advertising, AI in marketing, and join a team that is building the best creative advertising culture in the business. You will work directly on our Creative Team, which works with our clients to enhance their Creative Output. You will also work with both our Social Commerce team to enhance UGC creative and our Paid Media team to plug into their ad scaling strategies. Generally, your work will be the lifeblood of our ad programs.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance—combining bold visual storytelling with data‑informed design decisions. You’ll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short‑form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content. Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high‑volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data‑backed testing frameworks.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

What you’ll do:

  • Creative Strategy: Lead high‑tempo creative strategy and direction for full‑funnel ad programs, typically Meta and TikTok, but also YouTube, Amazon, and Display Platforms.

  • Short Form Video Expert: Deliver expert advice, concepts, directions, and briefs to sell products and services through short‑form video.

  • Data Analysis: Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts (This includes using metrics like thumb‑stop rate, hold rate, and click‑through rate. You’re super comfortable adapting creatives to impact these metrics.)

  • Cross‑Team Collaboration: Brief Designers and Editors on the creation of assets including static ads, animations, mobile‑first videos, and storyboards for short‑form content. You’re capable of jumping into shape up a design in Figma or whip up an ad yourself without concern, if need be. This isn’t the role for strategy‑only folks.

  • Executive Presentation: Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.

  • Performance Iteration: Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

  • 3+ years of creative strategy work on performance ad programs, with specific focus working on short form video and statics. If you have not made any short‑form video or driven creative strategy on Meta, this role is not for you.

  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance ad work that includes short‑form video, motion, and statics. Examples of what you did to impact metrics like hold rate or CTR. Evidence of strong creative diversity that includes both highly designed and low‑fidelity creative.

  • You can storyboard, cut, and ship ads. You can jump into Figma to fix hierarchy and pacing, and into Photoshop or Illustrator to polish assets. Strategy‑only folks will not be a fit.

  • You speak in hooks, angles, and metrics. You know thumb‑stop rate, 3‑second hold, hook retention, CTR, and CPA, and you use them to decide what to test next.

  • You already use tools like ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, Runway, or similar to increase speed and volume. You have shipped ads with AI‑assisted elements, not just experiments.

  • You’re an excellent communicator, both in writing and when presenting to clients. You give crisp, actionable feedback to designers and editors and know how to navigate pushback from clients.

  • You can turn vague goals into testable concepts, track results, and call the next iteration without hand‑holding.

  • Deep in Figma including Auto Layout, Components, and handoff. Strong in Adobe Creative Suite.

Hard disqualifiers

  • No Meta performance creative ad experience.

  • No portfolio link or no performance context.

  • Strategy‑only with no hands‑on design ability.

  • Not excellent in client presentation and salesmanship.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote , employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model , including weekly in‑office appearances . Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.
