description:
About InPlanet

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany and Brazil with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scalingEnhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is simple but bold:to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast. Our company culture blends people-first care andperformance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact. We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens. You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to check how people find interviewing with us. Check out our Culture page here

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure accurate and timely accounting and tax records following Brazilian GAAP and IFRS
  • Support financial consolidation across multiple entities and geographies
  • Drive or support the month-end and year-end closing processes
  • Support the Finance team in corporate finance, strategy, and investor relations
  • Ensure strong internal controls and help mitigate financial and operational risks
  • Coordinate compliance with local and international tax and accounting standards
  • Support treasury operations , including Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), and cash flow planning
  • Partner with FP&A to align operational and financial insights
  • Manage with external auditors and advisors during audits and reviews
  • Identify and lead process improvements to make our systems more reliable, efficient, and scalable

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust : You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes
  • Drive : You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field
  • 3-5 years of proven experience in controlling, accounting, or financial reporting roles
  • Deep understanding of Brazilian accounting standards , IFRS , and multi-entity consolidation
  • Strong command of Excel/Google Sheets and experience with financial systems
  • Familiarity with Accounting, Compliance, Treasury (AP & AR) , and FP&A
  • Advanced English communication skills
  • Excellent organizational and project management abilities
  • Collaborative, proactive, curious, and eager to learn
  • Goes above and beyond with a strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Hard-working and hands-on
  • Detail-oriented and analytical, with a problem-solving mindset
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally in a dynamic environment

Bonus Points (but not essential)

  • Experience in a Big 4 or audit firm
  • Experience in financial modeling and valuation
  • Proven track record in building or improving accounting and tax processes in cross-border or fast-growing companies
  • Previous experience in climate tech, sustainability, or international startup settings

Benefits

  • Compensation expectations and our comp philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly.
  • Home Office Budget
  • Fully Remote: (Brazil-based).
  • Personal development budget
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance
  • 40 days annual leave
  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference and belong to a vision.
  • Occasional off-sites in Brazil yay!
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity

About the Role

We’re looking for aFinancial & Controlling Analyst / Senior Financial & Controlling Analyst to join our Finance team and strengthen the foundation that supports InPlanet’s growth and impact. You’ll take care ofAccounting & Tax, Financial Reporting, Internal Controls, and Risk Management , ensuring that our operations remain solid, compliant, and ready to scale globally. You\'ll be the kind of person who enjoys both getting things done and thinking strategically - structured, purpose-driven, and comfortable switching between hands-on tasks and higher-level discussions. The Impact you can make
Your work will make a real difference in how we grow — helping InPlanet stay financially healthy, transparent, and ready to make decisions that accelerate our mission of removing CO₂ from the atmosphere. You’ll help build and improve the processes that keep our numbers reliable and our teams confident in their decisions.
Core working relationships
You’ll collaborate closely with:

  • Our Finance Leadership
  • Operations, People, and Science teams
  • External accounting and tax partners

InPlanet Compensation Philosophy

title: Analista de Suporte N2 – Redes
description:
Analista N2 Pleno

Empresa

Somos um provedor de internet em crescimento, focado em qualidade, estabilidade e atendimento próximo aos nossos clientes.

Missão do cargo

Garantir que a rede funcione de forma estável, resolvendo problemas técnicos de clientes e da infraestrutura, atuando entre o atendimento N1 e a engenharia/N3.

Atividades principais

  • Atender chamados escalados pelo N1 (casos que o N1 não conseguiu resolver).
  • Analisar conectividade:
    • Testes de ping e traceroute (IP e domínio).
    • Identificar se o problema está no cliente, na rede interna, no POP, na rota ou na operadora.
  • Acessar e analisar OLT GPON (ZTE, Huawei, Fiberhome, Nokia ou similar):
    • Ver potência RX/TX das ONUs.
    • Ver ONUs flutuando (online/offline).
    • Verificar erros e utilização das portas GPON.
  • Verificar e ajustar VLAN, PPPoE, IPoE e DHCP:
    • Sessões PPPoE travadas.
    • Cliente autenticando e não navegando.
    • Cliente sem IP ou recebendo IP incorreto.
  • Apoiar o time de campo com diagnóstico técnico (indicar provável ponto de falha).
  • Utilizar ferramentas de monitoramento (Zabbix, Grafana ou similares) para identificar e prevenir instabilidades.
  • Registrar nos chamados o passo a passo do diagnóstico e da solução.

Requisitos técnicos (obrigatórios)

  • Experiência prévia em provedor de internet ou suporte de redes.
  • Bom conhecimento de TCP/IP (IP, máscara, gateway, DNS, rota).
  • Entender bem PPPoE e/ou IPoE.
  • Saber trabalhar com VLAN (ACCESS/TRUNK, tagged/untagged).
  • Noções sólidas de IPv4 e NAT.
  • Uso prático de ping, tracert/traceroute e testes por IP e domínio.
  • Conhecimento básico em ao menos um equipamento de borda, por exemplo: Mikrotik, Cisco, Huawei ou similar.
  • Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de logs (roteador, OLT, servidor PPPoE/DHCP).

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios, mas contam ponto)

  • Experiência com OLT GPON (ZTE, Huawei, Fiberhome, Nokia, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de CGNAT / BNG / BRAS.
  • Experiência com Zabbix, Grafana ou outras ferramentas de monitoramento.
  • Noções de IPv6.
  • Cursos ou certificações em redes (MTCNA, CCNA, etc.).
  • Já trabalhou em provedor de internet.
  • Sabe mexer em OLT GPON na prática (ver potência, ONU, porta, erros).
  • Usa Mikrotik ou similar no dia a dia.
  • Consegue resolver a maioria dos problemas sem supervisão.
  • Já trabalhou com redes/provedor.
  • Conce sabe TCP/IP, PPPoE, VLAN.
  • Atua com OLT GPON + Mikrotik + monitoramento (Zabbix/Grafana).
  • Entende bem PPPoE, IPoE, VLAN, NAT, CGNAT/BNG.
  • Consegue segurar plantão e dar suporte ao time como referência técnica.

Perfil comportamental

  • Gosta de resolver problema até o fim, sem “empurrar para o outro”.
  • Sabe trabalhar sob pressão, mantendo calma e foco.
  • Boa comunicação com N1, N3 e técnicos de campo.
  • Organização para registrar tudo o que faz.
  • Vontade de aprender e crescer junto com a empresa.

  • Horário: segunda a sexta, das 09h às 17h
  • Sábado, das 09h às 13h

description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

As an Editor at Darkroom, your primary duty will be to develop and assist in the development of marketing collateral, including video content and organic content. Our Editors add immense value to our client's work through native content and strategies. The ideal candidate is someone who is passionate about using their editing skills to tell a compelling story and help our customers grow their businesses.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, and Spain.

Who You Are:

  • Experience creating platform native content (including video content and organic content), especially IG Reels, Meta ads, and TikTok viral video campaigns

  • Exceptional time management and organization skills with the ability to manage deliverables across an array of brands

  • Strong Motion Graphics/ Graphic Design/ Typography skills required

  • Proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro + FCPX

  • Working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (especially Media Encoder, After Effects, Premiere, and Photoshop)

  • Familiarity with broadcast finishing workflows (mix, color, VFX, conform, online)

  • Familiarity working in a networked server environment

  • Strong technical knowledge of codecs and transcoding practices

  • Strong time management skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong communication skills

  • Proficient with animation/ graphic design preferred

What You'll Do:

  • You will be editing UGC-style videos in a variety of content formats

  • Develop and execute thumb-stopping social media video edits, layer audio seamlessly and overlay text that drives key brand messaging

  • Brainstorm inventive edits and hooks that drive engagement, leverage new formats

  • Stay current on all social media platforms, ad offerings, content publishers, tools, trends, and best practices

  • Be a creative collaborator: Have the ability to be the voice of the brand and the influencer to create content that is authentic and powerful for all channels

  • Be comfortable using video editing software, editing audio, and taking editing direction, while working in a fast pace environment

  • Provide accessible content that includes closed captioning, voiceover, and overlay text in a variety of aspect ratios

  • Setting up projects for edit staff

  • Ingesting and logging footage

  • Working in tandem with edit staff to meet deadlines

  • Editing lower-level projects

  • Maintaining media storage (hard drives, servers, GDrive)

  • Mastering deliverables and archiving projects

  • Assisting senior staff with edit and administrative needs

  • Versioning various aspect ratios of completed edits

  • Maintaining all software and assets (Mac OSX, server operating system, frame.io, Vimeo, shared assets)

  • Coordinating and troubleshooting edit equipment

  • Reporting to the Post-Production Supervisor and Producers, the AE will upon request create high-quality video edits that will span various media platforms

  • Performance creative editing (collaborating with the performance marketing team in reviewing ad analytics/performance)

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote , employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model , including weekly in-office appearances . Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. title: FF&E Supply chain Manager
description:
This position will work closely with Interior Designers and Senior FF&E Procurement Manager to maintain FF&E budgets, project procurement, supply chain, logistics and project installations. We are seeking a highly organized and experienced FF&E Supply Chain Project Manager to oversee the full logistics, quality control, and delivery process for a luxury residential hospitality project in Brazil. This role is responsible for managing production follow-up, factory coordination, inbound logistics from multiple regions, storage operations in Preá, and final-mile delivery into Jericoacoara—an area with challenging access conditions.

The ideal candidate has strong project management skills, experience in complex supply-chain environments, and the ability to work collaboratively with vendors, factories, construction teams, installers, and logistics partners.

  • Mid‑Senior role overseeing end‑to‑end FF&E supply chain for a luxury hospitality project in Brazil
  • Responsible for factory supervision, quality control, and production sign‑off (Brazil & Europe)
  • Manages storage operations in Preá and all inbound logistics
  • Coordinates last‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara with specialized 4x4/off‑road vehicles
  • Oversees inventory accuracy, documentation, dispatch & receiving
  • Plans and supervises loading/unloading, equipment rental, and batch delivery scheduling
  • Works closely with Construction for delivery timelines, site readiness, and installation planning
  • Supervises Utopia‑hired installers to ensure deadlines, quality standards, and contractual commitments
  • Must be highly organized, proactive, and experienced in complex or remote logistics environments

Responsibilities

Production Oversight & Quality Control

  • Supervise FF&E production at each factory (Brazil & Europe)
  • Conduct detailed quality checks and approve inventory before packing and sign‑off
  • Ensure all items meet Utopia's standards for quality, specifications, and finishes

Inbound Logistics & Storage Management

  • Monitor and confirm the arrival of goods at the Preá storage facility
  • Arrange and oversee loading/unloading operations at all locations
  • Hire necessary local equipment or machinery as required
  • Maintain a full, accurate, and continuously updated inventory of all items

Documentation & Compliance

  • Handle all dispatch, receiving, and transport paperwork
  • Ensure complete documentation for internal controls and auditing

Delivery Coordination & Final‑Mile Logistics

  • Oversee delivery schedules from factories to Preá, ensuring timely arrivals
  • Plan and manage logistics from Preá to Jericoacoara—including batch deliveries due to access restrictions (large trucks cannot cross dunes)
  • Hire and coordinate appropriate 4x4 or off‑road trucks capable of operating in sandy conditions
  • Supervise all loading/unloading operations for the Preá‑Jericoacoara transfers

On‑Site Coordination & Installation Support

  • Coordinate delivery timelines and equipment needs with the Construction team
  • Organize and supervise unpacking activities
  • Oversee Utopia‑hired installation teams to ensure full compliance with contract requirements, deadlines, and quality standards

Requirements

Professional Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in FF&E logistics, supply chain management, project management, or procurement—preferably in hospitality or high‑end residential projects
  • Proven experience supervising factory production, performing quality checks, and managing sign‑off processes
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate international and domestic logistics (Brazil + Europe preferred)
  • Experience managing storage facilities, inventory systems, and warehouse operations
  • Solid track record overseeing loading/unloading operations, equipment rental, and transport coordination
  • Hands‑on experience with remote or difficult‑access job sites (desert, beach, island, jungle environments are a strong plus)
  • Experience coordinating with construction teams, installers, and multiple vendors simultaneously
  • Prior responsibility for delivery scheduling, documentation, and compliance
  • Experience supervising installation teams is highly desirable
  • Portuguese and English a must—any other language a plus

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of FF&E manufacturing processes, materials, finishes, and quality standards
  • Proficiency in inventory management tools, tracking systems, and documentation workflows
  • Understanding of logistics planning, especially final‑mile or off‑road delivery constraints
  • Familiarity with transport regulations, customs basics, and dispatch/receiving procedures
  • Strong reporting and documentation skills (photos, checklists, receiving logs, QC reports)
  • Ability to read technical documents (spec sheets, shop drawings, BOQs)

Benefits

Salary and benefits are competitive and based on candidate experience.

Note: Please submit your CV in English.

description:
Bluelight Consulting is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting‑edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight Consulting. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high‑quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

What we are looking for

  • Experience with AWS services including but not limited to S3, Athena, EC2, EMR, and Glue.
  • Ability to solve any ongoing issues with operating the cluster.
  • Experience with the integration of data from multiple data sources.
  • Experience with various database technologies such as SQLServer, Redshift, Postgres, and RDS.
  • Experience with one or more of the following data integration platforms: Pentaho Kettle, SnapLogic, Talend OpenStudio, Jitterbit, Informatica PowerCenter, or similar.
  • Knowledge of best practices and IT operations in an always‑up, always‑available service.
  • Experience with or knowledge of Agile Software Development methodologies.
  • Excellent problem‑solving and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills with a keen sense of customer service.
  • Experience with collecting/managing/reporting on large data stores.
  • Awareness of Data governance and data quality principles.
  • Well‑versed in Business Analytics including basic metric building and troubleshooting.
  • Understand Integration architecture: application integration and data flow diagrams, source‑to‑target mappings, data dictionary reports.
  • Familiar with Web Services: XML, REST, SOAP.
  • Experience with Git or similar version control software.
  • Experience with integrations with and/or use of BI tools such as GoodData (preferred), Tableau, PowerBI, or similar.
  • Broad experience with multiple RDBMS: MS SQLServer, Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redshift.
  • Familiarity with SaaS/cloud data systems (e.g. Salesforce).
  • Data warehouse design: star‑schemas, change data capture, denormalization.
  • SQL/DDL queries/Tuning techniques such as indexing, sorting, and distribution.
  • BS or MS degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.
  • 3+ years of Data Pipeline development such as SnapLogic or Datastage, Informatica, or related experience.
  • 3+ years of SQL experience (No‑SQL experience is a plus).
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining data pipelines.

What you'll be doing

  • Develop and maintain data models for core package application and reporting databases to describe objects and fields for support documentation and to facilitate custom application development and data integration.
  • Monitoring execution and performance of daily pipelines, triage and escalation of any issues.
  • Collaborate with analytics and business teams to improve data models and data pipelines that feed business intelligence tools, increasing data accessibility and fostering data‑driven decision‑making across the organization.
  • Implement processes and systems to monitor data quality, ensuring production data is always accurate and available for key stakeholders and business processes.
  • Write unit/integration tests, contribute to engineering wiki, and document work.
  • Perform data analysis required to troubleshoot data‑related issues and assist in the resolution of data issues.
  • Work within AWS/Linux cloud systems environment in support of data integration solution.
  • Work closely with a team of frontend and backend engineers, product managers, and analysts.
  • Teamwork: collaborate with team members, share knowledge, provide visibility of interpersonal accomplishments and follow directions when provided.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance‑based salary increases.
  • Generous paid‑time‑off policy.
  • Flexible working hours.
  • Work remotely.
  • Continuing education, training, conferences.
  • Company‑sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications.

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply.

Moffatt & Nichol is a leading infrastructure advisor specialising in the planning and design of facilities that shape and serve our coastlines. Reflecting Moffatt & Nichol’s commitment to design innovation since 1945, Engineering News-Record (ENR) has ranked the company No. 1 design firm for Marine and Port Facilities in the United States and No. 7 internationally.

Moffatt & Nichol's professional staff includes engineers, planners, scientists, and architects who serve our global client base from offices in Europe, the Americas, the Middle East and Asia Pacific. The firm provides clients worldwide with customised service and a level of excellence that have become the firm’s hallmark in three primary practise areas—coastal, environmental, and water resources; ports and harbours; and transportation, bridges, and rail.

  • Finite element static and dynamic structural modeling and analysis of structures

  • Prepare design calculations and check calculations
  • Coordinate detailed plan details with engineers and drafting technicians
  • Participate in field inspections, reports prepartions and in projects of rehabilitation of waterfront structures
  • Works in cooperation with other disciplines on multi-discipline projects

Other duties

Please note this job posting is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s of Science in Civil Engineering is required
  • Master’s of Science in Structural Engineering as a differential
  • Entry level with related internship experience or up to 2 years of industry experience
  • Civil engineer Licence CREA-RJ

Please provide cover letter and resume when applying.

Sedentary for prolonged period of time, interact with clients, and travel occasionally.

description:
Você é uma pessoa motivada, com vontade de crescer e construir uma carreira sólida? Busca um ambiente onde seu trabalho é valorizado e seu desenvolvimento profissional é uma prioridade? Então, temos a oportunidade perfeita para você! Em nossa empresa, valorizamos a dedicação, o comprometimento e o desejo de fazer a diferença. Como vigilante, você não estará apenas protegendo patrimônios; estará também zelando pela segurança e bem-estar de nossos colaboradores e visitantes. Sua atuação será fundamental para manter a ordem e a tranquilidade, tornando o ambiente mais seguro para todos. Em nossa empresa oferecemos, investimos no crescimento dos nossos colaboradores com treinamentos contínuos e oportunidades de desenvolvimento de carreira. Se você está pronto para assumir um papel essencial, onde seu trabalho será valorizado e terá um impacto positivo na segurança e tranquilidade de muitos, envie seu currículo e venha fazer parte da nossa equipe de vigilantes. Aqui, seu crescimento profissional é nossa prioridade. Não perca a chance de integrar uma equipe dedicada e crescer em um ambiente que valoriza o seu potencial. Junte-se a nós e comece uma jornada de sucesso como vigilante! Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você e contar com seu talento em nossa equipe.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar rondas periódicas nas instalações para prevenir e detectar sinais de intrusão, roubo, vandalismo ou outras atividades ilegais.
  • Controlar e registrar a entrada e saída de pessoas, veículos e materiais nas dependências dos clientes.
  • Controlar a entrada de visitantes e prestadores de serviços, garantindo que estejam devidamente cadastrados e acompanhados.
  • Identificar e relatar situações de risco ou condições inseguras, tomando ações preventivas para evitar acidentes ou incidentes.
  • Atuar de forma rápida e eficiente em situações de contingência, como incêndios, acidentes ou invasões, seguindo os procedimentos estabelecidos.
  • Colaborar com as forças de segurança pública em casos de crimes ou distúrbios.
  • Manter registros precisos de atividades diárias, incidentes, ocorrências e outras informações relevantes.
  • Preencher relatórios de ocorrência e comunicar aos superiores sobre quaisquer incidentes significativos.
  • Oferecer atendimento cordial e profissional aos colaboradores, visitantes e prestadores de serviços, fornecendo informações e orientações quando necessário.
  • Auxiliar na organização e controle de eventos internos.

O vigilante é responsável por garantir a segurança e integridade das instalações e pessoas, prevenindo ações criminosas e respondendo prontamente a contingências. Este profissional deve ser atento, proativo e capaz de atuar de forma eficaz em situações de risco.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Curso de formação de vigilante com reciclagem em dia.
  • Experiência prévia na área de segurança patrimonial ou funções similares.
  • Conhecimento básico em informática e sistemas de vigilância eletrônica.
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em turnos, incluindo noites, fins de semana e feriados.
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Capacidade de lidar com situações de stress e tomar decisões rápidas.

Informações adicionais

  • Vale Refeição - por dia de trabalho
  • Vale Transporte - ida e volta por dia de trabalho
  • Seguro de Vida

This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit , and read about the latest news via our StoryHub .

Description and Requirements

We are Lenovo! We’re a leader in genuine innovation, dreaming up – and building – the technology and services that enable and inspire progress around the world. Our innovative high-quality PCs & Smart Devices, Data Centers, Mobile and Smart Office products are designed and built with the customer in mind. And it’s our people who make this all happen - we believe different is better and our strength lies in this diversity.

Lenovo is the Number 1 Supercomputing provider in the world measured by Top 500 entries, and we keep going. Our Data Center team is dedicated to fostering an environment that encourages entrepreneurism and ownership - a workplace where your talents can be challenged, and your efforts recognized and rewarded.

We are currently hiring for an HPC System Administrator to work onsite with one of our customers based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

Responsibilities

As part of the Lenovo Managed Services team your responsibilities will include:

  • Monitoring, maintaining, and managing the physical infrastructure of a data center, ensuring its smooth operation, reliability, and security.
  • Monitoring power and cooling systems and network connectivity.
  • Hardware and system software debugging and troubleshooting.
  • Addressing hardware and software issues.
  • Responding to alerts, performing preventative maintenance, rolling out and upgrading firmware versions, and managing any issues that may arise to minimize downtime and optimize data availability.
  • Become the customers’ Single Point of Contact (SPOC).
  • Opening hardware trouble tickets against different vendors.
  • Following up and reporting the progress on all issues. Respond to users and provide support to them on the daily operations of the cluster.
  • Daily system administration tasks including granting and deleting access.
  • Investigate and correct hardware defects in the cluster as reported, adhering to the service levels.
  • Resolve errors through developing, testing and implementing changes to the system.
  • Provide corrective and preventive maintenance, troubleshoot and isolate defects.
  • Perform Software and firmware testing for any fixes, upgrades, security patch.
  • Update the customers’ documentation when and as necessary to reflect the changes made to the system.
  • Compile Monthly Reporting and take part in monthly customer Service Reviews where required.

Working directly with the customer you will be responsible for:

  • The installation, configuration, and the support of services as required within the central customer Research Computing Services platform team.
  • Work with vendors and customer Technology Office to design, implement and upgrade services using change management and revision.
  • Control processes to ensure that changes are properly tracked and available for audit when required.
  • Analyze and troubleshoot system issues, defining, and resolving complex issues.
  • Develop innovative solutions to continuously improve HPC and address any shortfalls in provision.
  • Work closely with other customer staff, including Infrastructure Technology, Security and Governance teams.
  • Understand the importance of security and seek specialist security advice to secure systems.
  • Maintain a knowledge of technical developments, tools, and ideas in HPC, attending seminars, conferences, technical briefings, and other community events.
  • Work flexibly as a part of the customer Platform Team, supporting the group’s activities and undertaking individual projects.
  • Write and maintain documentation on system design and management processes to ensure knowledge is accessible and disseminated appropriately within the customer team.
  • Deliver a high-quality service through a collaborative approach and outstanding analytical skills.
  • Take an active part in meetings, representing the customer, and facilitating collaboration between partners.
  • Assist customer researchers to utilize the HPC resource, providing subject matter expertise support to the Customer Research Computing Analysts.

The role gives you a great deal of independence and opportunity to take the lead and advise. You will be expected to work effectively in providing technical services in the areas of Server, Storage, Network, Power and Cooling, OS, and cluster management software.

The job responsibilities involve providing knowledge transfer, troubleshoot, resolve and advise on the mentioned infrastructure and technologies, continuously monitoring critical data center parameters.

The role includes incident management by quickly identifying and resolving issues raised by alerts, including hardware failures, network disruptions, and power fluctuations.

The position will require you to build a solid customer relationship, so it is important that you possess customer interaction skills and ability to make technical decisions, to collaborate during projects with several organization verticals, partners, and customers and to develop training and knowledge base documentation.

Position requirements

  • Experience in system troubleshooting, monitoring, and support.
  • Experience in System administration.
  • Experience in Hardware support, Hardware break-fix, Hardware replacements and installations.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese languages.
  • Able to perform OS installation and upgrades with no supervision.
  • Able to perform high level problem determination.
  • Customer service skills including written and oral communication with client.

What Lenovo can offer you:

  • An exciting job with great opportunities for success.
  • A good potential to grow both professionally and personally.
  • You will be a part of the Number 1 PC vendor in the world.
  • Stimulating office environment.
  • Flexibility and working from home possibility.

title: Analista de Suporte N2 - Redes
description:
Missão do cargo

Garantir que a rede funcione de forma estável, resolvendo problemas técnicos de clientes e da infraestrutura, atuando entre o atendimento N1 e a engenharia/N3.

Atividades principais

  • Atender chamados escalados pelo N1 (casos que o N1 não conseguiu resolver).
  • Analisar conectividade: testes de ping e traceroute (IP e domínio); identificar se o problema está no cliente, na rede interna, no POP, na rota ou na operadora.
  • Acessar e analisar OLT GPON (ZTE, Huawei, Fiberhome, Nokia ou similar): verificar potência RX/TX das ONUs, ONUs flutuantes (online/offline) e erros e utilização das portas GPON.
  • Verificar e ajustar VLAN, PPPoE, IPoE e DHCP: sessões PPPoE travadas; cliente autenticando e não navegando; cliente sem IP ou recebendo IP incorreto.
  • Apoiar o time de campo com diagnóstico técnico (indicar provável ponto de falha).
  • Utilizar ferramentas de monitoramento (Zabbix, Grafana ou similares) para identificar e prevenir instabilidades.
  • Registrar nos chamados o passo a passo do diagnóstico e da solução.

Requisitos técnicos (obrigatórios)

  • Experiência prévia em provedor de internet ou suporte de redes.
  • Bom conhecimento de TCP/IP (IP, máscara, gateway, DNS, rota).
  • Entender bem PPPoE e/ou IPoE.
  • Saber trabalhar com VLAN (ACCESS/TRUNK, tagged/untagged).
  • Noções sólidas de IPv4 e NAT.
  • Uso prático de ping, tracert/traceroute e testes por IP e domínio.
  • Conhecimento básico em pelo menos um equipamento de borda, por exemplo: Mikrotik, Cisco, Huawei ou similar.
  • Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de logs (roteador, OLT, servidor PPPoE/DHCP).

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

  • Experiência com OLT GPON (ZTE, Huawei, Fiberhome, Nokia, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de CGNAT, BNG e BRAS.
  • Experiência com Zabbix, Grafana ou outras ferramentas de monitoramento.
  • Noções de IPv6.
  • Cursos ou certificações em redes (MTCNA, CCNA, etc.).
  • Experiência comprovada em provedor de internet, com habilidade em resolver a maioria dos problemas sem supervisão e gerenciamento de plantões.

description:

This position will support FPSO operations by overseeing and ensuring the integrity of all metering systems. It will involve monitoring system performance, validating data, and providing daily operational support. The role will also act as the Technical Authority for metering, ensuring compliance with technical and regulatory requirements, including ANP and INMETRO standards.

Responsibilities

  • Responsible for ensuring that all fluid metering systems at FPSO are performed in accordance with the technical requirements and legal deadlines, meeting the requirements outlined in Joint Resolution ANP / INMETRO 01: 2013 (RTM)
  • Provide technical support daily, in relation to measurement problems in the FPSO
  • Participate or assist in metering audits
  • Act as Technical Authority for measurement issues
  • Verify that FPSO operator's procedures and manuals are in accordance with current ANP, ISO and other relevant standards for offshore oil and natural gas flow measurement (fiscal, allocation and operational)
  • Manage and monitor the status of the flow metering systems (fiscal, allocation and operational)
  • Conduct critical analysis of failure reports, calibrations and periodic maintenance of fiscal, allocation and custody transfer metering systems in accordance with RTM and applicable standards
  • Verify, validate and submit data (failure reports, flow computer data, well test reports and monthly production report) related to the FPSO metering systems to ANP
  • Keep measurement points registered in the SFP (ANP production system) updated
  • Validate offloading measurement reports
  • Verify the operational history of seal removal and installation
  • Verify that the FPSO operator is following calibration plans, uncertainty calculations, and required flow computer upgrades
  • Verify / validate in case of measurement system failure the volume estimate as specified in ANP resolutions
  • Verify / monitor backups of measurement equipment information, fault history, equipment replacement, and parameter changes
  • Carry out the planning and control of the sample collection service for chemical analysis, interface with logistics for loading and unloading materials related to the samples, and, if necessary, validate the results of PVT and chromatographic analysis. After validation, monitor the results/inform the need to update the flow computers
  • Follow up on routines to keep the Metering Management System in operation without non-conformities

Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Automation, Petroleum, Production, Chemical Engineering or related

Knowledge and Skills

  • Good understanding and knowledge of FPSO marine & process systems
  • Familiar with engineering/industry standards such as API, ASME, ASTM, NACE, etc.
  • Advanced English (oral and written)

  • Mid-Senior level

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

MISSÃO DO CARGO

Sobre a Vaga:

Na Laços Saúde, acreditamos que o cuidado deve ser um reflexo da individualidade de cada pessoa, promovendo a autonomia e a qualidade de vida dos nossos pacientes. Como parte do nosso compromisso com um modelo inovador de assistência, buscamos Fisioterapeutas Visitadores , apaixonados pela transformação do cuidado à saúde no ambiente domiciliar, seguindo os princípios do modelo Buurtzorg, que prioriza o autocuidado e a manutenção das funcionalidades das pessoas em suas próprias comunidades.

Diagnóstico que Buscamos:

  • Formação em Fisioterapia e registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Fisioterapia (CREFITO).
  • Experiência prévia em atenção domiciliar ou saúde comunitária será um diferencial.
  • Paixão por promover o autocuidado e a autonomia dos pacientes, com uma abordagem centrada na pessoa.
  • Habilidade em comunicação e empatia, fundamentais para o estabelecimento de vínculos com pacientes e familiares.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa e multidisciplinar, integrando ações que promovam a saúde do paciente no seu ambiente familiar.
  • Proatividade na busca de soluções que promovam a qualidade de vida e a funcionalidade dos pacientes.

Sobre Nós

Na Laços Saúde, a diversidade é o coração do nosso trabalho. Acreditamos que cuidar é um ato de amor e acolhimento, e isso se reflete em nossa equipe, que é composta por profissionais de diversas origens e experiências. O modelo Buurtzorg que adotamos é mais do que um método: é uma filosofia que prioriza o cuidado comunitário, respeitando a individualidade e as necessidades de cada pessoa. Se você é umFisiotarapeuta que acredita na transformação do cuidado à saúde, venha fazer parte da nossa equipe e ajude a moldar o futuro da saúde no Brasil. Aqui, cada dia é uma nova oportunidade de fazer a diferença na vida das pessoas.

Tem Paixão pelo Cuidado? Então junte-se a nós!

A Laços Saúde está pronta para receber você!

Vamos juntos cuidar da saúde da comunidade!

Proporcionar cuidados de alta qualidade, respeito, compaixão e empatia aos idosos, promovendo o seu bem-estar físico, emocional e psicológico, garantindo a segurança e a integridade do paciente, prevenindo e tratando eventuais problemas de saúde relacionados a mobilidade humana. O Fisioterapeuta com ênfase no tratamento de idosos, desempenha um papel crucial na educação do paciente, praticando cuidados adequadas e promovendo orientações e acompanhamento para o envelhecimento saudável e digno.

RESPONSABILIDADES

Atuar em consonância com os valores da organização, mantendo conduta focada em resultados do Cuidado, respeitando a individualidade de cada paciente, tornando a assistência personalizada.

Registrar no Prontuário do Paciente as informações inerentes e indispensáveis ao processo de cuidar, mantendo-os atualizados.

Ser representante da organização, zelando por suas premissas, prestando cuidado baseado em evidências científicas e melhores práticas.

Realizar o Cuidado Integral ao Paciente, cuidando com Empatia e Carinho, estabelecendo vínculos e considerar as suas necessidades biopsicossociais.

Garantir a continuidade da Assistência em Fisioterapia, por meio da execução do Plano de Cuidado estabelecido.

Distribuir adequadamente a agenda de consultas, cumprindo a carga horária e número de atendimentos, conforme o contrato estabelecido.

title: Analista de RH - Desenvolvimento Organizacional
description:
O Analista de Recursos Humanos – Desenvolvimento Organizacional é responsável por planejar, implementar e acompanhar programas de desenvolvimento humano, organizacional e de liderança, alinhando as práticas de RH à estratégia da empresa. Atua diretamente no desenho de processos, identificação de necessidades de capacitação, gestão de programas de desempenho e cultura organizacional.

O Analista de RH – Desenvolvimento Organizacional é peça-chave para promover a cultura de aprendizagem, fortalecer competências e alinhamento dos colaboradores à estratégia de uma empresa inovadora e dinâmica. Profissional deve combinar conhecimento técnico, visão estratégica e habilidade para engajar pessoas e liderar transformações organizacionais.

Principais Atividades e Atribuições

  • Diagnóstico e levantamento de necessidades de treinamento e desenvolvimento para todas as áreas da empresa.
  • Desenvolvimento e implementação de programas de integração, capacitação técnica, comportamental e de liderança.
  • Participação nos processos de avaliação de desempenho, análise de resultados e elaboração de planos de ação.
  • Apoio à gestão de clima organizacional, incluindo aplicação de pesquisas, análise de dados e promoção de ações de melhoria.
  • Condução de projetos voltados à cultura organizacional e employer branding.
  • Suporte em iniciativas de mudança organizacional e novos modelos de trabalho.
  • Gestão de trilhas de aprendizagem e relacionamento com fornecedores de treinamentos.
  • Elaboração e acompanhamento de indicadores (KPIs) da área de desenvolvimento.
  • Organização de eventos internos voltados para engajamento, capacitação e reconhecimento de colaboradores.
  • Atuação em projetos de diversidade e inclusão.
  • Apoio em ações de comunicação interna.

Requisitos e Qualificações Necessárias

  • Formação superior completa em Psicologia, Administração, Gestão de RH ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência anterior comprovada em desenvolvimento organizacional e/ou treinamento e desenvolvimento.
  • Conhecimento dos principais subsistemas de RH, especialmente Desenvolvimento e Clima.
  • Vivência em empresa de grande porte, preferencialmente do setor de transportes e logística.
  • Pacote Office intermediário/avançado.
  • Vivência com plataformas de treinamento online (LMS) e ferramentas de avaliação.

Competências Técnicas

  • Técnicas de treinamento e desenvolvimento.
  • Ferramentas de assessment e avaliação de desempenho.
  • Elaboração de indicadores de RH.
  • Metodologias de aprendizagem (presencial/híbrida/EAD).
  • Análise e gestão de clima e engajamento.
  • Gestão de projetos em RH.

Habilidades e Competências Comportamentais

  • Organização e planejamento.
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita.
  • Proatividade e iniciativa.
  • Capacidade analítica e visão sistêmica.
  • Relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Adaptabilidade a mudanças e ambientes dinâmicos.
  • Foco em resultados e experiência do colaborador.
  • Trabalho em equipe e colaboração.
  • Empatia e escuta ativa.

title: Coordenador de Operações de Transportes - Rio de Janeiro
description:
O Coordenador de Operações de Transportes é responsável por coordenar e supervisionar todas as operações do contrato garantindo que sejam executadas de forma eficiente. Planejar e otimizar cada processo pois o objetivo é maximizar a eficiência operacional e minimizar custos. Os indicadores de desempenho são também sob sua responsabilidade, devendo assim acompanhar essas métricas, identificar áreas de melhoria e implementar ações corretivas para otimizar os resultados. Além disso, é o representante DeLuna como ponto de contato entre a empresa, fornecedores e clientes. Outro aspecto importante é a construção de um ambiente de trabalho positivo e colaborativo, que é essencial para o sucesso organizacional. Estabelecer uma visão compartilhada, construir um ambiente de trabalho positivo, atribuir tarefas de forma equilibrada, incentivar o desenvolvimento dos membros da equipe e demonstrar habilidades de resolução de conflitos e tomada de decisões.

Competências necessárias :

  • Excelentes habilidades de liderança e comunicação;
  • Proatividade e capacidade de resolver problemas de forma eficiente;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão e tomar decisões rápidas;
  • Atenção aos detalhes e alto nível de organização;
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe e colaborar com diferentes áreas da empresa;
  • Flexibilidade e adaptabilidade para lidar com mudanças e novos desafios.

As principais Responsabilidades incluem:

  • Elaborar Planos de Ações para garantir resultados pactuados no Planejamento Estratégico Empresarial;
  • Acompanhar Indicadores de Desempenho, elaborar processos para melhoria contínua, garantir execução;
  • Assegurar a gestão, implementação e treinamento dos Procedimentos Operacionais;
  • Coordenar Operações Logísticas, bem como projetos e implementações de novas Operações;
  • Garantir resultados pactuados com o Cliente, elevando o nível de serviços e satisfação por meio de alta performance e gestão. Realizar atendimento direto ao Cliente com propósito de melhorar e expandir continuamente as operações de transportes;
  • Maximizar a rentabilidade das operações, acompanhar orçamento e controle agindo para garantir os resultados financeiros pactuados, gerindo processo de perdas e eliminando prejuízos operacionais;
  • Fazer Gestão Estratégica de Pessoas para que todos gerem resultados, buscando o processo de crescimento por meio da evolução dos Colaboradores.
  • Treinar, acompanhar e monitorar desempenho dos Colaboradores da área de Operações: Supervisores, Líderes, Encarregados e Dispatchers. Implementar rotina de Gestão.
  • Fazer Gestão de Relacionamento com os Prestadores de Serviços de Transportes, garantindo a implementação da cultura e requisitos da organização;
  • Acompanhando e auxiliar o processo de captação e retenção de Prestadores;
  • Realizar as Reuniões Matinais com os Prestadores de Serviços.

A Formação necessária para essa função é Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Logística, Engenharia ou afins. Desejável pós-graduação.

Os Conhecimentos necessários são:

  • Experiência comprovada em planejamento estratégico, gestão de operações logísticas e transportes, sendo um diferencial vivência em Last Mile e/ou E-Commerce;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de gestão de transporte (TMS) e ferramentas de rastreamento;
  • Habilidade em análise de dados e geração de relatórios de performance;
  • Conhecimento das regulamentações e normas de segurança no transporte de mercadorias;
  • Capacidade de planejamento e organização para gerenciar múltiplas tarefas e prioridades.

title: Técnico de Manutenção - Volta Redonda / RJ
description:
Técnico de Manutenção - Volta Redonda / RJ

Manter os equipamentos em perfeito estado de funcionamento, realizar manutenção técnica, limpeza geral, acompanhar terceiros na solução de problemas quando estes fogem de nossa alçada, realizar testes e vistorias frequentes nos dispositivos de segurança, conservar o aspecto visual, iluminação do ponto, implantar melhorias visando a satisfação do cliente.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar atendimentos operacionais dos PCs: repor suprimentos, papel e filtro de ar, substituir consumíveis e trocar peças, baixar aplicativos, realizar vistorias dos PCs, verificar se estão em perfeitas condições, acompanhar fornecedores para reparos técnicos, configurar softwares e manter atualizada a comunicação visual do ponto.
  • Reparar e trocar componentes que apresentem defeito no equipamento, identificado por meio de conhecimento técnico. Solicitar peças para a Logística através das ferramentas do sistema ETA e transportadoras.
  • Liberar o ponto para que o responsável pela manutenção (pode ser da concessionária de telecomunicações, empreiteiro, empresa que faz manutenção) possa executar o reparo no defeito.
  • Estar atento aos dispositivos de segurança dos equipamentos, observando se não há tentativas de fraude. Utilizar conhecimentos técnicos sobre o funcionamento do sistema e testes para manutenções quando necessário.
  • Garantir boa sinalização e iluminação dos pontos, aspectos visuais como pintura, adesivos e limpeza, utilizando materiais de limpeza e peças de reposição, além de acionar empreiteiras quando necessário para atividades além do escopo.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Escolaridade: Técnico ou superior completo em elétrica, eletrônica, mecatrônica, mecânica, informática ou afins;
  • Conhecimentos de microinformática (hardware e software);
  • Imprescindível saber dirigir e possuir CNH B definitiva;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar finais de semana e feriados (escala 5x2).
